title: Phases
description: The build's planned phases, in order: the list ideation lays out, kept current as phases are added, split, reordered or dropped. The agent edits it; the cockpit's Phases tab shows it, numbering each phase by its place.

phases.description: One entry per planned phase, in the order they run.

name.description: The phase's name, as `nexus phase start` would take it.

description.description: What the phase delivers, in a sentence or two.
